flagged.evidence: The title asserts "Trivial action on the standard meridians fixes the punctures and the stem arcs up to isotopy". The Statement instead concludes "h(s_i) is homotopic to s_i relative to endpoints" and declares that no choice principle is used. Proof 4.1 explicitly says: "The intermediate paths need not be embeddings; upgrading this homotopy to an isotopy is a separate proper-arc result." That separate scoped proper-arc lemma assumes AC. Thus this item's proof establishes compact endpoint homotopy, not the isotopy advertised by its title.
